method: enumerate all 20 lock-preserving attraction/meal interleavings; independent interval checker; no production scheduler imports
source_limitations: Historic 2026-10-15 places/hours/durations combined with 2026-10-24 AMap route responses

Meal restaurant pool is explicitly the current two restaurants; other restaurants/modes/new points require new version
No true model evaluation or human quality acceptance performed
